cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:56b.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO & CTO
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:56b.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: Chief Executive Officer; primary executive partners are the CEO and Chief Technology Officer Location: US & Canada (Remote), with regular travel to work in person with the CEO and CTO; Austin, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, or Toronto preferred. Candidates must reside in one of these locations and be comfortable with hybrid work.
responsibilities: Executive Decision System
Capture material decisions and convert them into a durable decision log (decision, rationale, owner, effective date, revisit conditions) and a policy/governance register.
Identify contradictory or stale decisions and force resolution before teams execute against different interpretations.
Broadcast concise decision summaries to the right operators while protecting confidentiality.
Executive Cadence & Priority Governance

Run the operating cadence for the CEO–CTO partnership: agendas, pre-reads, decision prompts, action registers, and follow-through. Improve or kill meetings without a clear decision, problem, or review purpose.
Maintain a single view of top-priority initiatives with named DRIs, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
Ensure commitments survive the meeting — confirm owners and deadlines, track completion, escalate misses.
Metrics, Economics & Experiment Rigor
Preflight executive analyses: verify sources, definitions, calculations, and assumptions before they reach the CEO or CTO.
Package recommendations in decision-ready form — what we believe, why, what could disprove it, confidence level, next action.
Partner with Finance, Data, Product, Engineering, and brand teams to turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses.
Use AI aggressively to accelerate research and execution, while independently validating AI-generated claims, code, and calculations before they inform decisions.
Strategic Initiatives & Cross-Functional Execution
Own a small portfolio of top-priority initiatives end-to-end — from problem definition through implementation and handoff.
Step into ownerless but important work, build enough structure to execute, and transition it once stable.
Coordinate dependencies across technology, data, finance, growth, and operations; remove blockers and escalate tradeoffs without becoming a permanent substitute for functional ownership.
Operational Risk & Control
Run a risk-intake funnel for high-impact FinOps, security, data-governance, and vendor issues, with severity, owner, and deadline.
Convert spend anomalies, system limits, and recurring alerts into tracked remediation.
Surface pressure toward undocumented or risky workarounds so the accountable leader makes the tradeoff explicitly.
Give the CEO and CTO a concise view of what's off track, what changed, who owns it, and what decision (if any) is needed.
qualifications: 7+ years in strategy and operations, a founder's/executive office, consulting, banking, finance, product operations, or technical program leadership.
Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can compress messy context into a precise decision memo without losing nuance.
Strong business and financial fluency (P&Ls, unit economics, business cases, experimental measurement).
Enough technical fluency to work credibly with engineering, data, AI, and security leaders, and to spot an incomplete answer.
Demonstrated ability to independently validate analyses and AI-assisted work.
Track record of driving ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from unclear problem to measurable result.
Excellent judgment on what needs executive attention, what to delegate, and what to document.
High discretion, low ego, and the confidence to give direct, evidence-backed pushback to senior leaders.
Strong systems thinking — you build mechanisms that survive after you hand off the work.
Comfort operating at high velocity across time zones, with periodic travel for executive sessions.

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:4c23158a-79f9-40.title: Account Executive, Solana
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:4c23158a-79f9-40.description: About Alchemy Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. About the Role As an Account Executive. You will be Alchemy’s tip of the spear in the Solana ecosystem — building, closing, and expanding partnerships with top apps, infra providers, and ecosystem players. You’ll be equally comfortable in a hackathon booth, on a stage at Breakpoint, or in a multi-threaded deal cycle with a Series B founder and their engineering lead. This is a builder’s role. You’ll shape our Solana GTM engine from the ground up — from identifying the most strategic accounts to partnering with product and engineering on roadmap priorities. What You’ll Do - Drive new business and expansion within the Solana-native developer ecosystem across DeFi, NFTs, gaming, infra, and emerging categories. - Leverage your existing Solana network to open doors, accelerate trust, and shorten sales cycles. - Collaborate directly with the Solana Foundation, SuperTeams, and ecosystem partners on joint GTM motions. - Represent Alchemy at top Solana events, hackathons, and community meetups globally. - Run a tight product feedback loop with our Solana engineering team to keep us ahead of the competition on performance and features. - Work closely with marketing on co-marketing, case studies, and success stories that make “Powered by Alchemy” a mark of trust in Solana. What we’re looking for - Deep relationships in the Solana ecosystem and the ability to activate them. - 5–8+ years in B2B sales or BD with a track record of hitting/exceeding targets in high-growth, technical markets. - Experience closing partnerships with startups and scaling teams, ideally in dev tooling, infrastructure, or adjacent categories. - The ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous markets — and to build the playbook as you go. - A genuine passion for Web3, crypto infrastructure, and Solana’s mission. Benefits and Perks 🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🚅 Commuter Benefits 🌴 Flexible Time Off 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks 🧠 Learning & Development Stipend 🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events 💸 HSA and FSA Plans 🧬 Fertility Benefits Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a4bc5af5-072e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Affiliate Marketing Specialist based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to own an affiliate marketing program from strategy through execution in a fully remote, global environment. You’ll be responsible for growing affiliate-driven revenue while building a strong pipeline of high-performing creators. The position combines relationship management, performance analysis, platform administration, and experimentation. You’ll optimize commission structures, tracking, incentives, and the affiliate funnel to maximize results. Working closely with influencer marketing, finance, and operations teams, you’ll help turn creator relationships into measurable business growth. This is a highly performance-oriented role suited to someone who thrives on data, ownership, and continuous optimization. Own and manage the affiliate program end to end, including affiliate onboarding, platform administration, relationship management, and ongoing program optimization. Set and manage commission structures, promotional codes, tracking links, incentives, and affiliate payouts, ensuring accuracy and timely processing. Monitor key performance indicators such as clicks, conversions, affiliate-driven revenue, and creator contribution, and use insights to guide optimization decisions. Build and maintain a pipeline of high-performing affiliates by sourcing new creators, evaluating performance, and identifying creators who could advance into paid partnership opportunities. Maintain strong relationships with affiliates through regular communication, program updates, incentives, and performance feedback to keep top creators engaged. Conduct ongoing A/B testing across different stages of the affiliate funnel to improve conversion and revenue performance. Ensure affiliate content and disclosures comply with applicable FTC requirements and brand standards. Monitor affiliate activity for fraud, coupon abuse, tracking issues, and other policy violations, resolving escalations when needed. Partner with finance and operations teams on payout reconciliation, reporting, and program administration. Use program data to identify growth opportunities, improve creator performance, and determine where resources and investment should be prioritized. Requirements 3+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, or a closely related performance-marketing discipline. Experience managing an affiliate program through platforms such as AspireIQ or comparable affiliate-management technology. Strong understanding of commission structures, affiliate payouts, tracking, conversion metrics, and performance optimization. Demonstrated ability to use data to identify opportunities, evaluate creator performance, and determine actionable next steps. Strong spreadsheet skills, including proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel for tracking, analysis, and reporting. Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, particularly when managing a high volume of affiliate relationships and financial transactions. Clear, professional written communication skills with the ability to engage creators and internal stakeholders effectively. Strong performance mindset, ownership mentality, and bias toward action, with the ability to prioritize opportunities that have the greatest business impact. Working knowledge of FTC disclosure requirements for affiliate and influencer content is preferred. Experience with AspireIQ specifically is a plus. Experience in food, beverage, wellness, or consumer products is advantageous. Experience supporting gifting programs or paid creator partnerships is a plus. Familiarity with community platforms such as Google Groups, Discord, or similar tools is beneficial.
